metadata.description: The name of the Sentinel workspace

properties.displayName: MITRE T1037: Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts
properties.description: Detects ATT&CK technique T1037 (Boot or Logon Initialization Scripts). Adversaries may use scripts automatically executed at boot or logon initialization to establish persistence.(Citation: Mandiant APT29 Eye Spy Email Nov 22)(Citation: Anomali Rocke March 2019) Initiali
properties.query: SecurityEvent | where EventID == 4688 | where NewProcessName contains "mitre" or CommandLine contains "t1037" | summarize count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 5m), Computer, Account, NewProcessName | where count_ > 5 // AZ-MITRE-ATTACK-030
